approval_meaning: Reviewed as needed roadmap/build work based on current primary-source research and fit with DreamCo. This is not a claim that implementation or certification has already passed.

themes.name: Agent Observability
themes.research_basis: Production agents need traces, evaluations, monitoring, optimization, and business-value measurement because model/tool behavior can drift.

themes.name: Agent Evaluation
themes.research_basis: Multi-turn, tool-using agents require rigorous evals to detect behavioral regressions before production.

themes.name: Agent Interoperability
themes.research_basis: The agent ecosystem is converging around protocols including MCP, A2A, UCP, AP2, A2UI, and AG-UI, reducing bespoke integration work.

themes.name: Software Supply Chain
themes.research_basis: Dependency provenance, SBOMs, attestations and immutable releases improve software supply-chain transparency and integrity.

themes.name: Agent Sandbox Governance
themes.research_basis: Autonomous coding agents need clear access boundaries, approval gates and agent-native telemetry for safe deployment.

themes.name: Long-Horizon Agent Work
themes.research_basis: Agentic work is shifting toward delegated tasks lasting minutes or hours and parallel agent execution, requiring checkpoints and resumability.

themes.name: Local Multimodal AI
themes.research_basis: Developer-sized multimodal models can increasingly run locally, creating privacy, latency, offline and cost-routing opportunities.

themes.name: Software Asset Intelligence
themes.research_basis: Modern software asset management emphasizes reuse, inventory, provenance and supply-chain security at scale.

themes.name: Agent ROI
themes.research_basis: Leading AI adopters differentiate through deeper delegated workflows, governance, enablement and measurement rather than seat count alone.

themes.name: Agentic Software Engineering
themes.research_basis: Coding agents increasingly understand repositories, use tools, modify code, run tests and prepare work for human review rather than only autocomplete.
